description: Graph-layer pointer/fingerprint binding an actor to a real-world dataset it HOLDS. The actor's own did:key signs it; the canonical projection + raw blob live in the etzhayyim repo + DataLad/IPFS layer (ADR-2607010001 §D4). The same anchor fields are the RAD dataset:<id> sub-entity, so a holding has ONE field set, TWO representations: the signed RAD journal datom (sovereign attestation) and this signed graph record (runtime-discoverable pointer). holderRank names the ONE canonical owner per dataset.

main.description: A signed dataset pointer in the actor's PDS collection. Pointer-only by construction — bulk data never lives here; it lives at cidv1 in the repo+IPFS tier.

datasetId.description: Stable dataset identifier. MUST equal :rad/dataset-id in the RAD journal, :dataset-id in the *.kotoba.edn header, and ingest-id in ingest-provenance.json.

layer.description: graph = small signed pointer/fingerprint lives here; repo = canonical projection + raw blob live in the etzhayyim repo + IPFS/DataLad tier. A dataset may have a graph pointer whose cidv1 points at the repo-tier directory CID.

source.description: Origin service, e.g. wikidata:WDQS, gleif, nyc-pluto, fr-dvf, edgar, tdnet.

cidv1.description: Directory CID or canonical-projection CID. For layer=repo this MUST equal the directory CID at the holding repo's HEAD (pin==HEAD invariant).

freshnessDays.description: Re-ingest window in days; 0 = static reference (no stale-check).

retrieved.description: YYYY-MM-DD the dataset was last fetched.

holderRank.description: canonical = this actor is the canonical holder (attests the dataset); mirror = replicated from the canonical holder for local presentation. Exactly ONE actor holds canonical rank per dataset (ownership invariant).

countsTowardWorldCoverage.description: True if this dataset sums toward world-coverage accounting (mirrors the jinushi ingest-provenance field).
